summary: US and Iranian diplomatic efforts continue amid ongoing military preparations, with both sides maintaining readiness for potential escalation. Israeli forces have conducted strikes targeting Hezbollah and Hamas operatives in Lebanon and Gaza. Mourning ceremonies for Iranian religious figures are scheduled, reflecting continued regional tensions.
key_points: US diplomatic efforts continue to reduce tensions in the US-Iran conflict, with both sides maintaining military readiness while allowing diplomatic channels to take priority (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75409).
Israeli forces destroyed two underground bunkers in the Gaza Strip, measuring approximately 200 meters in length and containing hundreds of Hamas operatives (Source: @idf_telegram/24585).
Four residents of the Negev were arrested on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack against police forces and a central station in Arad (Source: @yediotnews25/132510).
Israeli intelligence shared information with the United States indicating Iran was considering a new plot to assassinate President Donald Trump (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4799).
Explosions were reported in Karaj, Iran, according to local media reports (Source: @inon_yttach/9349).
Israeli strikes in Gaza killed a commander in Hamas's sniper operatives, Abdullah Baha al-Din Razak al-Souti (Source: @manniefabian/58755).
Israeli strikes in Gaza killed Rashid al-Qadhi, a commander in Palestinian Islamic Jihad's weapon production division (Source: @manniefabian/58755).

sections.threat_assessment: The situation remains highly volatile with ongoing military preparations on both sides of the US-Iran conflict. Israeli operations continue to target Hamas and Hezbollah infrastructure in Gaza and Lebanon respectively. The potential for escalation remains high given the ongoing diplomatic tensions and military readiness on all sides.
sections.regional_response: Regional diplomatic efforts continue with both US and Iranian sides maintaining military readiness while allowing diplomatic channels to take priority. Gulf Cooperation Council member states are acquiring advanced Russian air defense systems, indicating regional military modernization. Lebanese army operations continue in the aftermath of recent conflicts.
sections.intelligence_notes: US naval forces have loaded weapons onto fighter jets aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea, with pilots conducting readiness exercises for potential attacks. Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps leadership funeral arrangements are being made at religious sites. Israeli settler activists have attempted multiple illegal border crossings into Syria, prompting military intervention.
